items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who is Richard, your buddy. [INTERVIEWEE] No, he was Chicken Richards.

ctx.x: Two guys, it was. They used to do that thing to everybody (Unintelligible) You were there -- no, it wasn't, it was across the street. What was the name of that act? It had the controversial thing, where he would say, don't go there because you're going to get sick, and he would say, okay --
Open the door, Richard. Who was he?
